included_categories: Top Class School Education for Secondary Students
Pre-Matric Assistance for Special Categories (Persons with Disabilities, Labour/Mine Workers)
excluded_categories: Professional & Technical Degree Scholarships (Engineering, Medical, Law, etc.)

eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class 7 (50% for SC/ST) to appear in the selection test (MAT/SAT) conducted in Class 8; continued clear progression for renewal.
eligibility_criteria.school_type_requirement: Students studying as regular students in Government, Government-aided, or Local Body schools. (Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, and private residential schools are not eligible).
eligibility_criteria.selection_mode: State-level competitive selection exam consisting of Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT).

financial_assistance.disbursement_frequency: Monthly / Yearly (₹1,000 per month directly deposited via DBT)

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: High-impact merit scholarship targeted directly at secondary school students entering Class 9 from economically weaker backgrounds studying science and general subjects.

schemes.scheme_name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI) - Pre-Matric Scholarship
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Passed Class 8 examination from a recognized school; regular full-time student in Class 9 or 10.
eligibility_criteria.social_category: Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), or De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT/SNT) not covered under SC/ST.

financial_assistance.disbursement_frequency: Annual consolidated academic allowance via DBT

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Centrally sponsored pre-matric scholarship explicitly targeted at Class 9 and 10 students from backward and disadvantaged communities in government schools.

schemes.scheme_name: PM-YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Meritorious students who have secured admission in identified Top Class Schools (TCSs) across India.
eligibility_criteria.school_type_requirement: Shortlisted/notified Top Class Schools (including top private and specialized residential schools).

financial_assistance.details: Covers full tuition fees, hostel fees, and other non-refundable charges up to ₹75,000 per annum for Classes 9 and 10 (up to ₹1,25,000 for Classes 11-12).

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Flagship school-level scheme providing premium institutional support for high-performing secondary students in Classes 9 and 10.

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)

eligibility_criteria.disability_requirement: Minimum 40% disability certified by competent medical authority with a valid UDID / Disability Certificate.
eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Studying as a regular, full-time student in Class 9 or Class 10 in a government or government-recognized school.

financial_assistance.details: Includes maintenance allowance (₹500/month for day scholars, ₹800/month for hostellers), annual book grant of ₹1,000, and disability allowances (braille/escort/reader allowances up to ₹4,000/yr).

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Critical accessibility and financial inclusion scheme for disabled students completing secondary education in Class 9 and 10.

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students and Others (Component I - Class IX & X)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Regular student studying in Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school.
eligibility_criteria.school_type_requirement: Government schools, schools run by local bodies, or recognized private schools.

financial_assistance.details: Academic allowance of ₹3,500/year (Day Scholar) to ₹7,000/year (Hosteller) plus 10% disability allowance if applicable.

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Centrally sponsored scheme designed to curb dropout rates at the secondary level for SC students transitioning into Class 9 & 10.

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students (Class IX & X)

eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Regular, full-time student enrolled in Class 9 or Class 10.

financial_assistance.details: Consolidated academic allowance and maintenance grant (₹3,000 - ₹6,250 depending on day scholar vs hosteller status).

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Core tribal education initiative addressing secondary school retention for Class 9 and 10 tribal students.

schemes.scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education of the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers (Pre-Matric)

eligibility_criteria.occupational_requirement: At least one parent must be an active worker in Beedi, Cine, Iron Ore/Manganese Ore/Chrome Ore (IOMC), or Limestone and Dolomite Mines (LSDM) with at least 6 months of continuous service.
eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Passed previous year examination on first attempt and enrolled in a recognized school.

financial_assistance.details: For Class 9 and 10 students: ₹2,000 per annum (Class 1-4: ₹1,000, Class 5-8: ₹1,500).

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Direct financial aid scheme specifically for children of unorganized mine and factory workers attending secondary school (Classes 9 and 10).

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities (Class IX & X)

eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in previous final examination.
eligibility_criteria.school_type_requirement: Government or private recognized secondary schools.
eligibility_criteria.social_category: Notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis).

financial_assistance.details: Tuition fee up to ₹4,000/year (or actual) plus maintenance allowance (₹500/month for hostellers, ₹100/month for day scholars).

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Key minority welfare scheme supporting Class 9 and 10 secondary students who meet academic and income thresholds.

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Children of Parents Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility_criteria.occupational_requirement: Children of parents engaged in manual scavenging, tanners, flayers, waste pickers, and hazardous cleaning as defined by MoSJE.
eligibility_criteria.academic_requirement: Enrolled in a recognized institution in Classes 1 through 10.

financial_assistance.details: Monthly scholarship of ₹700 (Day Scholars) / ₹1,100 (Hostellers) for Class 9-10 plus annual ad-hoc grant of ₹1,000.

schemes.registration_requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
schemes.inclusion_rationale: Affirmative action scheme guaranteeing secondary education support for children of marginalized sanitation and leather workers with no restrictive income cap.
